A potentiometer, a chip, and nothing else

Two WebAssembly modules in one tab. The emulator runs real ESP32-C3 firmware that reads GPIO 3 with the stock adc_oneshot driver. potentiometer.wasm, built from examples/parts/potentiometer, holds its wiper's voltage on that pad. Turn the knob and the next reading follows.

Pick the two files this page runs. The firmware is test_apps/adc_oneshot built for esp32c3 (its merged flash image). The part is potentiometer.wasm, built from examples/parts/potentiometer.
